title: Passive Mobs
description: Makes it so an player listed in the configuration model will not be targeted and attacked by mobs.
body:
The mod generates a server-side configuration file for each world or server environment.

1. Launch your world or server once with the mod installed.
2. Navigate to <your_world_name>/serverconfig/.
3. Open passivemobs-server.toml using any text editor.
4. Add the exact Minecraft usernames of the players you want to be ignored by hostile mobs to the passivePlayers list.
